text: Saturday, one in the morning, the stolen phone lights up in the thief's pocket.
prefix: Saturday, one in the morning, the stolen phone lights up in the thief's pocket.

text: It is a push from the bank.
prefix: It is a push from the bank.

text: The thief leans in to read it, and finds nothing worth reading.
prefix: The thief leans in to read it, and finds nothing worth reading.

text: Why does a message from the bank carry so little, on purpose?
prefix: Why does a message from the bank carry so little, on purpose?

text: In Lesson 12, TAF sent the codes in the master app, and in Lesson 26, the bank's SMS service sent them in the side apps.
prefix: In Lesson 12, TAF sent the codes in the master app, and in Lesson 26, the bank's SMS service sent them in the side apps.

text: This lesson collects every message the platform sends: which road it takes, whom it may reach, and what it may say.
prefix: This lesson collects every message the platform sends: which road it takes, whom it may reach, and what it may say.

text: First, the roads.
prefix: First, the roads.

text: The platform has no messaging contract of its own.
prefix: The platform has no messaging contract of its own.

text: Every SMS goes through the SMS service of the bank, and every push goes through the push service, in the Firebase project of the bank.
prefix: Every SMS goes through the SMS service of the bank, and every push goes through the push service, in the Firebase project of the bank.

text: Codes follow the app.
prefix: Codes follow the app.

text: In the master app, TAF sends the code, and the bank's SMS service sends it only while TAF is down.
prefix: In the master app, TAF sends the code, and the bank's SMS service sends it only while TAF is down.

text: In a side app, on a phone or on the web, the bank's SMS service always sends it.
prefix: In a side app, on a phone or on the web, the bank's SMS service always sends it.

text: Only the code message carries a code, and a push never does.
prefix: Only the code message carries a code, and a push never does.

text: Second, the addresses.
prefix: Second, the addresses.

text: An SMS goes only to the number of the registration, or to the verified number of the customer.
prefix: An SMS goes only to the number of the registration, or to the verified number of the customer.

text: A push goes only to the devices of the customer.
prefix: A push goes only to the devices of the customer.

text: Now, how does a message leave without getting lost?
prefix: Now, how does a message leave without getting lost?

text: Say Aziz changes his password.
prefix: Say Aziz changes his password.

text: In the same database transaction, the platform writes the new password digest, and a row in the outbox: send password changed.
prefix: In the same database transaction, the platform writes the new password digest, and a row in the outbox: send password changed.

text: A relay publishes that row to Kafka, and a worker hands it to the SMS service or the push service.
prefix: A relay publishes that row to Kafka, and a worker hands it to the SMS service or the push service.

text: If the platform crashes in the middle, the row is still there, and the relay sends it later.
prefix: If the platform crashes in the middle, the row is still there, and the relay sends it later.

text: And if the change itself fails, there is no row, so there is no message about a change that never happened.
prefix: And if the change itself fails, there is no row, so there is no message about a change that never happened.

text: The services send back delivery reports, and the platform records them.
prefix: The services send back delivery reports, and the platform records them.

text: A failed dispatch goes again, as often as the configured retry policy says, and then the platform records it as failed.
prefix: A failed dispatch goes again, as often as the configured retry policy says, and then the platform records it as failed.

text: Third, what must be sent.
prefix: Third, what must be sent.

text: Some messages are security notifications, and the customer cannot switch them off.
prefix: Some messages are security notifications, and the customer cannot switch them off.

text: A new session sends a push to all his other sessions, and an SMS to his verified number, with the app, the device model, the network address and the time.
prefix: A new session sends a push to all his other sessions, and an SMS to his verified number, with the app, the device model, the network address and the time.

text: A login from a new device, a password change, a locked password, a block, an unblock: each one has its own template, and each one goes out.
prefix: A login from a new device, a password change, a locked password, a block, an unblock: each one has its own template, and each one goes out.

text: Now the rule from Lesson 31.
prefix: Now the rule from Lesson 31.

text: When Aziz taps this was not me, his number goes on hold.
prefix: When Aziz taps this was not me, his number goes on hold.

text: From then on, every message goes by push only, and no SMS goes to that number while it is on hold.
prefix: From then on, every message goes by push only, and no SMS goes to that number while it is on hold.

text: The reason is simple: the person who holds that SIM card may be the person Aziz is running from.
prefix: The reason is simple: the person who holds that SIM card may be the person Aziz is running from.

text: Fourth, what a message may say, and this is where the thief comes back.
prefix: Fourth, what a message may say, and this is where the thief comes back.

text: No message contains document data or the personal identification number.
prefix: No message contains document data or the personal identification number.

text: No message has a name other than the first name, and no message has a link that starts an action.
prefix: No message has a name other than the first name, and no message has a link that starts an action.

text: A message about a login may show the device model, the network address and the time.
prefix: A message about a login may show the device model, the network address and the time.

text: And a push never contains a code, a text or personal data.
prefix: And a push never contains a code, a text or personal data.

text: It carries only the type of the message and a reference.
prefix: It carries only the type of the message and a reference.

text: The app gets the words afterwards: it asks the platform for the text with the reference.
prefix: The app gets the words afterwards: it asks the platform for the text with the reference.

text: Only a device of the customer can get that text, in the customer's language, from the template version that was published when the message left.
prefix: Only a device of the customer can get that text, in the customer's language, from the template version that was published when the message left.

text: So the thief on Saturday night sees, at most, which kind of message the bank sent.
prefix: So the thief on Saturday night sees, at most, which kind of message the bank sent.

text: I think this is the most honest design for a phone that can be lost: the push is a doorbell, not a letter.
prefix: I think this is the most honest design for a phone that can be lost: the push is a doorbell, not a letter.

text: The push service is outside the bank's perimeter, so it learns nothing about Aziz either.
prefix: The push service is outside the bank's perimeter, so it learns nothing about Aziz either.

text: And when the push service is down, notifications go by SMS only.
prefix: And when the push service is down, notifications go by SMS only.

text: Last, the words themselves.
prefix: Last, the words themselves.

text: Each template exists in the four languages.
prefix: Each template exists in the four languages.

text: Compliance changes a template with maker-checker, and the platform keeps every version.
prefix: Compliance changes a template with maker-checker, and the platform keeps every version.

text: The audit event of each message names the version that was sent.
prefix: The audit event of each message names the version that was sent.

text: To recap: two roads, the bank's SMS service and the push service, and codes by TAF in the master app and by the bank's SMS in side apps.
prefix: To recap: two roads, the bank's SMS service and the push service, and codes by TAF in the master app and by the bank's SMS in side apps.

text: An outbox so nothing is lost, security notifications that nobody can switch off, no SMS to a number on hold, and pushes that carry only a type and a reference.
prefix: An outbox so nothing is lost, security notifications that nobody can switch off, no SMS to a number on hold, and pushes that carry only a type and a reference.

text: But each of these messages also became an audit event.
prefix: But each of these messages also became an audit event.

text: Months from now, someone will ask what really happened on Friday night.
prefix: Months from now, someone will ask what really happened on Friday night.

text: How does the bank prove it, and prove that nobody changed the proof?
prefix: How does the bank prove it, and prove that nobody changed the proof?
